raw_segments.text: Pisannio, how, of adultery! Wherefore, write you not what monsters her accuse!
Leonidas, O master, what a strange infection is fallen into thy ear! What false Italian,
as poisonous dungood as handed, hath prevailed on thy too ready hearing!
Disloyal! No, she's punished for her truth, and undergoes more goddess-like than wife-like,
such assaults as would take in some virtue! O my master, thy mind to her is now as low
as were thy fortunes! How, that I should murder her!
Upon the love, and truth, and vows, which I have made to thy command, I her, her blood!
If it be so to do good service, never let me be counted serviceable!
How look I, that I should seem to lack humanity so much as this fact comes to!
